audit.recode_to: No change to kind/rule (fixed-dominant, penultimate penultimate stress stands). Re-cite to Crowley 2002:627 sec. 1.3 (quote above) with Clark 2009:24 (< Walsh 1966:19) as corroboration; add the secondary-stress rule/secondary = alternating leftward from the penult; keep not in the strict set on the strength of Clark's 'mainly'.
audit.reasoning: Identity: Glottolog hano1246 'Hano' = Raga of North Pentecost; the Wikipedia article carries glottorefname=Hano and Crowley/Clark/Duhamel all describe the same language (/raxa/, ~4000-6500 speakers, N Pentecost) -- no identity problem. (1) Quote check: no copies we hold; the Wikipedia sentence exists verbatim (wikitext line 115) but is unsourced. (2) Deciding source is a tertiary web page while Glottolog lists a 2011 PhD grammar, a 2002 published sketch, a 1966 phonology thesis and a 1938 grammar; so the record was under-sourced, not wrong. (3) Opened now: Crowley 2002:627 states penultimate primary stress with alternating secondary stress leftward (refines: adds secondary pattern); Clark 2009:24 'mainly penultimate (Walsh 1966:19)' (confirms, with a hedge consistent with not in the strict set); Duhamel 2020 is silent on synchronic stress.
